split_cc.accepted_device_id: 0x10; fail closed on unreviewed silicon revisions
split_cc.current_advertisement: Default USB current only; no 1.5 A or 3 A
split_cc.cable_policy: Only TYPE 0x08 Attached.SRC is accepted. TYPE.ACTIVECABLE/Ra is rejected; e-marked or VCONN-dependent cables may not power the satellite. Compatibility with every USB-C cable is not claimed.
split_cc.fault_recovery: Latch off until upstream USB unconfiguration, then complete reinitialization
split_cc.enable_n_inactive: ODR=1 releases to the FUSB303B internal bias, not driven 3.3 V
split_cc.external_enable_pullup: R609 DNP in final factory-reviewed assembly; preserve that assembly and selected open-drain policy. Rev2 and Rev3 EN_N rating differences are recorded separately.
split_cc.enable_n_absolute_max_source: Current FUSB303B/D September 2024 Rev3, Table4 p7 VIO. Earlier April 2022 Rev2 separately limits EN_N to 2.0 V; reason for document difference is unknown. Absolute maxima are not recommended drive voltages.

R609.reason: Preserve the final factory-reviewed order configuration: external 100k EN_N pull-up omitted.
R609.selected_firmware_policy: PE15 GPIO_MODE_OUTPUT_OD + GPIO_NOPULL; high releases EN_N, low enables. This is a policy for the reviewed DNP assembly, not the sole electrically valid drive method.

upstream_usb.initial_programming: SWD on each half; native USB-FS pins are not routed and no USB firmware updater is implemented

split_connection.signals: RS-485 plus switched power, not PC USB data
split_connection.power_gate: Right half supply remains blocked until the configured left USB/FUSB source policy permits it

en_n_electrical_correction.corrects_attribution: The historical 2026-10-21 review incorrectly attributed the 2.0 V EN_N limit to Rev. 3. That separate limit exists in the archived Rev. 2; current Rev. 3 lists EN_N under VIO at 6.0 V.
en_n_electrical_correction.revision_difference_cause: Unknown from these documents; no assertion of silicon changes or applicability to a particular received lot.
en_n_electrical_correction.assessment: 3.3 V is below the current Rev. 3 EN_N absolute maximum, so a universal 3.3 V overvoltage claim is unsupported. Preserve the reviewed R609 DNP assembly and selected open-drain policy conservatively; physical EN_N voltage and startup/disable timing remain untested.
